title: Catalyst–electrolyte interface engineering propels progress in acidic CO2 electroreduction
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05715E, Review Article
Yunling Jiang, Linsen Huang, Chaojie Chen, Yao Zheng, Shi-Zhang Qiao
The acidic CO2RR is an alternative to the alkaline/neutral CO2RR, mitigating carbonate formation and carbon crossover. This review covers its history, evaluation, advances and challenges, focusing on catalyst–electrolyte interface engineering.
